opening.argument: The video frames itself as comedic call trolling directed at people identified as scammers: “In this video I will be trolling these scammers to the point of insanity.” Its purpose is reinforced by the closing warning to “help spread the word so nobody else falls for these disgusting scams,” which tells viewers to avoid the depicted conduct rather than accept an offer from the uploader. The technical-support greeting, computer-fix request, address language, and legal threats belong to participants in the calls being tested or entertained, including “Thank you for calling Technical Support This is J. How may I help you?” They are not presented as the uploader’s financial, credential, or participation offer. The request to follow the uploader on Twitter is ordinary audience engagement, unconnected to money, credentials, or a financial offer.
